files.html:
0.1.9 Change Log

  • Improved Stat Builder panel components
  • Fixed the Stat Builder save bug
  • Fixed config policy conflicts with Dochi's Warfare
  • Improved DRM addon policy in Mods Config
  • Improved the Remnant Message UI
  • Fixed the Faction Editor not working in a server environment
  • Fixed GeckoLib compatibility options not being selectable in the Dialogue Editor
  • Fixed GeckoLib animations not playing in the Dialogue Editor
  • Added many missing translation keys
